source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST POST /collections/{name}/points/query -> query_points (query_api.rs:32) -> check_strict_mode -> dispatcher.toc().query_batch (toc/point_ops.rs:358) -> get_collection (point_ops.rs:376): collection already removed => Err(NotFound) => HTTP 404 (graceful, observed 32/40); collection still present => Collection::query_batch (collection/query.rs:445) holding Arc<Collection> across awaits. Concurrent DELETE thread: delete_collection (collection_meta_ops.rs:211) -> collections map remove -> removed.stop_gracefully() -> Collection::stop_gracefully (mod.rs:325, takes shards_holder write lock) -> ShardHolder::stop_gracefully (shard_holder/mod.rs:136) std::mem::take(&mut self.shards) empties the shard map. An in-flight query that passed get_collection before the remove then executes against the torn-down shard set; the batch machinery degrades to an empty per-query result (via the shard_requests.is_empty() shortcut at query.rs:503 and/or zero-yield shard-response merging), and the outer Vec comes back empty. The REST guard query_api.rs:88-92 .pop() -> None -> StorageError::service_error('Expected at least one response for one query') -> HTTP 500 (helpers.rs:247; Display prefix errors.rs:21 matches the observed body verbatim). No existence re-check, no retry, no by-design annotation at the guard. The identical guard string is present unchanged in v1.18.1, v1.18.2, v1.18.3 and v1.19.0 clones.
source_grounding.note: Precise semantics of validation_absent here: the static missing-collection validation (get_collection -> NotFound -> 404) EXISTS and demonstrably works (32/40 raced queries got the documented 404); what is absent is race-safety for the lifecycle window — after the concurrent teardown, no code path re-validates collection existence before answering, and the empty-result guard hard-maps the raced outcome to 500. by_design_in_source is NOT available: the .ok_or_else guard carries no intent comment (no 'intentionally'/'by design' marker anywhere at the site), satisfying the v3.4 tightened rule that bare unannotated behavior cannot be marked by_design. The script docstring separately cites upstream qdrant #9229 as the known error family (prior-art pointer from dispatch materials, recorded not adjudicated).
